# Inputs of the daily release build (read by .github/daily-build/daily_gate.py
# from the commit being considered). A build is due only when the fingerprint
# of the selected files (path, mode, blob id) differs from the one recorded in
# the last build that was compiled AND published.
#   "+ glob" includes, "- glob" excludes, the last matching rule wins and
#   unmatched files are not inputs. "*" stays in one path segment, "**" crosses.
# Changing the rules changes the fingerprint (one rebuild). Comments do not.
version 1

# Product source, platform runners, lockfile, l10n config
+ apps/client/**
- apps/client/test/**
- apps/client/integration/**
- apps/client/tool/**
- apps/client/analysis_options.yaml

# Local dependency forks (dependency_overrides)
+ packages/**
- packages/*/test/**
- packages/*/example/**
- packages/*/doc/**
- packages/*/analysis_options.yaml
- packages/*/dart_test.yaml
- packages/*/dartdoc_options.yaml

# Documentation never changes a build (no .md file is a bundled asset)
- **/*.md

# Build recipe: pinned SDK installers and the daily build/packaging scripts.
# The gate/publish scripts, tests and README in .github/daily-build/ are not inputs.
+ tools/install_flutter_linux.sh
+ .github/workflows/daily-build.yml
+ .github/daily-build/recipe/**

# Windows engine helper used by the build (docs/INSTALLATION.en.md)
+ integration/native/build_rdp_windows.ps1
